t: For the purpose of providing day and residential facilities for secondary education for persons who are deaf in order to prepare them for college and other advanced study, and to provide an exemplary secondary school program to stimulate the development of similarly excellent programs throughout the Nation, there are authorized to be appropriated for each fiscal year such sums as may be necessary for the establishment and operation, including construction and equipment, of a model secondary school for the deaf to serve primarily residents of the District of Columbia and of nearby States, including sums necessary for the construction of buildings and other facilities for the school.

fable.w: This section only authorizes appropriations to establish and operate a model secondary school for the deaf. The tempting reading is that serving residents of the District of Columbia and nearby States, or stimulating similar programs nationwide, brings in outside parties, but they are only beneficiaries of the school. Nothing requires consultation, a hearing, an advisory body, rulemaking, or a right to sue before a federal decision.
fable.s: there are authorized to be appropriated for each fiscal year such sums as may be necessary for the establishment and operation, including construction and equipment, of a model secondary school for the deaf

qwen_block.w: This section is an authorization of appropriations for the establishment and operation of a school. It does not contain any language requiring consultation, coordination, or participation with outside parties (such as the public, states, or experts) in the decision-making process. The beneficiaries (students) are recipients of services, not participants in the government's decision to build the school.
qwen_block.s: For the purpose of providing day and residential facilities for secondary education for persons who are deaf in order to prepare them for college and other advanced study, and to provide an exemplary secondary school program to stimulate the development of similarly excellent programs throughout the Nation, there are authorized to be appropriated for each fiscal year such sums as may be necessary for the establishment and operation, including construction and equipment, of a model secondary school for the deaf to serve primarily residents of the District of Columbia and of nearby States, including sums necessary for the construction of buildings and other facilities for the school.

opus.w: This section only authorizes money to set up and run a model secondary school for the deaf. It mentions residents of the District of Columbia and nearby States, but only as the people the school will serve, not as people who take part in a federal decision. There is no consultation, advisory body, comment period, hearing, or right to sue, so nothing brings an outside party into federal decision-making.
opus.s: there are authorized to be appropriated for each fiscal year such sums as may be necessary for the establishment and operation, including construction and equipment, of a model secondary school for the deaf
opus.b:
**Step 1: Reasoning.** It might seem that this section involves outside parties, because it names "residents of the District of Columbia and of nearby States" and a goal of encouraging similar programs "throughout the Nation." That reading doesn't hold up. Those people are the ones the school will serve. Nobody outside the federal government is consulted, sits on an advisory body, comments, attends a hearing, or gets a right to sue before a federal decision. The section only authorizes funding for a school.

**Step 2: Label.**
